BLOCKING_ASSUMPTIONS: Arm labels are exchangeable inside a frozen stratum under the null.
The 60-minute refractory removes admitted-event overlap but residual dependence can remain.
A later burst inside the outcome window is contamination, not a reason to drop the event.
The contrast is associative. It does not identify maker inventory as the cause.
At matched high-volume BTC perpetual bursts, strong taker one-sidedness is associated with greater subsequent impact-per-volume persistence than a two-sided burst.
COUNTERFACTUAL_CLASS: Permute ONE_SIDED versus TWO_SIDED labels within the frozen matched strata. 10000 draws, seed 250251, p = (1 + count(T_perm >= T_obs)) / (1 + permutations).
ERA_INVARIANCE_RATIONALE: The frozen stability rule allows up to two of the five calendar years to miss the pooled positive sign. Cross-year invariance is not assumed.
EVENT_OR_STATE_DEFINITION: Primary cell only. BURST when quote volume >= linear quantile 0.999 of the preceding 43200 minutes. ONE_SIDE = 2*|taker_buy_quote/quote - 0.5|. One-sided if ONE_SIDE >= 0.7. Two-sided if ONE_SIDE <= 0.3. Admit only if the preceding 60 minutes contain no already accepted event. Do not drop an admitted event because a later burst falls inside its outcome window.

EXPECTED_EFFECT.RATIONALE: A one-sided-versus-two-sided difference smaller than 0.30 SD of the impact-ratio contrast is below the planning bar for a product-relevant liquidity-state description. The bar was set before C025 outcomes.

FALSIFIABLE_CLAIM: The preregistered claim fails unless the matched one-sided minus two-sided IMPACT_RATIO at 30 minutes is positive, the stratum-permutation p-value is at most 0.05, the standardized contrast is at least 0.30 SD, the contrast exceeds the mechanical-reversion placebo at the same alpha, and at least 3 of 5 calendar years have a positive point estimate.
FORBIDDEN_INTERPRETATION: proves maker inventory constraints caused the effect
MECHANISM: At a high-volume minute, taker flow that is strongly one-sided is associated with a larger subsequent impact-per-volume than a two-sided burst of similar pre-T conditions. The association is the claim. It is consistent with makers carrying inventory after the burst. It does not prove that inventory constraints caused the path.

NOMINAL_OBSERVATION_COUNT_CONSTRUCTION.EXCLUSION_RULE: Bars before the 30-day trailing window, neither-arm bursts, events inside the past-only 60-minute refractory, and events whose pre-impact is not positive. No post-T filter is applied in this count.
NOMINAL_OBSERVATION_COUNT_CONSTRUCTION.INCLUSION_RULE: BTCUSDT perpetual 1m bar in 2020-01..2024-12 whose quote volume is at or above the linear quantile 0.999 of the preceding 43200 quote volumes, whose one-sidedness is either >= 0.70 or <= 0.30, with a positive pre-impact over the preceding 60 minutes, and with no previously accepted event in the preceding 60 minutes.
